cover_letter:
Dear Redwire Space team,

At Episto I built and launched around 600 member profile pages on one consistent layout for a pharmacists' association, and I keep project data, documents and reporting in order every day. That is the kind of structured, detail-oriented work your PMO & Office Assistant role is built around, and it is why I am writing to you.

In my current role I track KPIs in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results, and I support a WooCommerce webshop with catalogue, product content and conversion pages. I work with Excel and Word daily, I am punctual and detail-oriented, and I like getting documents organized and structured in a digital system. I am hands-on and not afraid to take on new tasks. I work in English every day and I write and speak Dutch at a working level. I have my own car, so the daily trip to your Brussels office is no problem.

What appeals to me about Redwire Space is the end-to-end mission-critical work you do with customers, from concept development through mission operations. I want to be the person who makes sure project data is correctly reflected in the systems, that documents are released in the correct format, and that project reviews and invoicing run smoothly. I am comfortable being the first point of contact for questions on tools and for document exchanges with project teams, customers and subcontractors.

In the first weeks I would learn your PPM and configuration management tools, map how project documents and data packs are stored, and start supporting timesheet follow-up, meeting preparation and document control. I would like to talk with you about how I can support your project managers and Belgian leadership team.

Baver Ok

# Baver Ok

English (fluent) · Turkish (native) · Dutch (writing B1, speaking A2+)

## SUMMARY
I am looking for a hands-on role where documents and project data are organised and structured in a digital system, and where I can be the first point of contact for colleagues and guests. In my work I set up and maintain websites and webshops, keep client data and reporting in order, and follow up on tasks until they are closed. I am punctual and detail oriented, I communicate in English every day, and I am eager to learn new tools and processes. I work independently as well as in a team and deliver high quality outputs on time.

- Track KPIs (rankings, traffic, CTR) in Semrush, Ahrefs, GA4 and Search Console and report on results
- Support a WooCommerce webshop ([proteinbox.com.tr](https://proteinbox.com.tr)) with catalogue, product content and conversion pages
- Run keyword research, local and mobile SEO and link building for consulting, auto and e-commerce clients
